capabilities: Mark up edits as CriticMarkup suggestions with author and timestamp metadata
Anchor comment threads to text selections and reply or resolve them
Switch editors between editing, suggesting, and commenting modes
Enforce a note's editing mode through frontmatter keys
Accept or reject suggestions across a note or the whole vault from a Suggestion View
extras: Installable only through BRAT (stable repo AndrewBroz/obsidian-inkling, betas in a separate repo). The README warns not to click Update on old 0.11.x installs, because the old id 'inkling' now belongs to an unrelated plugin. The fork is in beta with 1,100+ automated tests but incomplete manual validation; the author recommends testing in a backed-up vault. Attribute-block metadata requires all collaborators on 0.13+.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Commentator.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to suggest edits, leave threaded comments, or review notes in a track-changes style.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Commentator.

summary: CriticMarkup editor that adds suggestion mode, text-anchored comments, and a comment-only review mode to notes.
